role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 戴泽天生就是战场上伙伴的辅助，受伤的队友在他的保护下能将死亡撒遍敌军之内。他奇特的魔法可以编织附近的铠甲，敌人大幅衰弱之际友军将异常坚挺。
hero_summary_en: Born to support his cohorts in battle, Dazzle keeps wounded allies alive so they might later rain death upon the enemy. His strange magic weaves its way into nearby armor, weakening enemies and strengthening friends.

abilities.name: dazzle_poison_touch
abilities.description_zh: 施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
abilities.description_en: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
notes_zh: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。
notes_en: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

abilities.name: dazzle_shallow_grave
abilities.description_zh: 友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的治疗效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
abilities.description_en: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
notes_zh: 在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。
notes_en: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

abilities.name: dazzle_shadow_wave
abilities.description_zh: 放出一道能量弧，可以瞬间跳跃至目标附近的队友，治疗的同时还将对附近的敌方单位造成伤害。施放暗影波时戴泽必定会享受到治疗效果。
abilities.description_en: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
notes_zh: 如果敌军附近有多个我方单位，那么他将受到多重暗影波的伤害。
notes_en: If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.

scepter_loc.en: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且治疗附近友军，数值为%scepter_heal_pct%%%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。

abilities.name: dazzle_innate_weave
abilities.description_zh: 戴泽的技能会对范围内友军和敌人同时施加编织，提升友军的护甲并减少敌人的护甲。本效果可以多次叠加。
abilities.description_en: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.

shard_loc.en: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
shard_loc.zh: 对友军施加编织时，每层编织效果治疗%ally_heal%点。

facet_text_en: Weave applies %ally_multiplier%x stacks to allies. Weave amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle by %heal_amplification_pct%%% per stack.
facet_text_zh: 编织会对友军施加%ally_multiplier%倍叠加层数。编织的每层叠加效果会使来自戴泽的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果增强%heal_amplification_pct%%%。
编织会对敌人施加%enemy_multiplier%倍叠加层数。

abilities.name: dazzle_nothl_projection
abilities.description_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：剧毒之触带有妖术效果；薄葬结束时会治疗；暗影波的冷却时间变短。效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
abilities.description_en: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
notes_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过%leash_start%距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。
notes_en: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.

shard_loc.en: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.
shard_loc.zh: 虚无投影可以在戴泽被控制时施放。他在虚无之境时治疗效果得到增强。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_dazzle_poison_touch_attack_range_bonus
talents_raw.desc_loc: +{s:bonus_attack_range_bonus} Attack Range when attacking an enemy affected by Poison Touch
